default/30130.htm.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: May the blessing of the abyss be with you! The massive structure you see behind me is the Temple of Shilen where we serve Shilen, mother of the abyss. I am the Abyssal Celebrant Undrias who serves our goddess.

links.text: Ask about the Dark Elf village

default/30130-1.htm.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: The Shilen Temple is a cultural treasure, with a history of more than 2,000 years. default/30130-2.htm.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: The Dark Elf village! The brilliant underground city and the product of our race's brilliant civilization and developed skills! The beauty is often compared to that of obsidian that shines a lucid light in the dark. To find the Dark Elf village, follow the road before me.…

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30130-05.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: Ah, you have brought the items we require for the Ceremony of Darkness. Excellent! Truly, the goddess will be pleased with our efforts. Take your reward and continue to serve Shilen faithfully.

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30130-02.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: Is this a piece from one of the lost statues of Shilen? Where did you find it? If you can recover enough pieces to reconstruct a whole statue, you will be richly rewarded!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30130-01.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: This sacred shrine is the only one of its kind on the entire continent. Yet the Humans spread lies about the goddess Shilen, denying that she is the giver of both life and death. When they invaded the Temple alongside those filthy Elves, many sacred objects were plundered…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30130-03.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: One of the lost statues of Shilen! Give it to me and you will be richly rewarded, that I promise you!

links.text: Refuse to give him the statue.

Q00166_MassOfDarkness/30130-03.htm.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: Excellent! First, retrieve the Ceremonial Dagger from Trader Iria at the Weapons Shop. Then acquire the Ritual Wine from Warehouse Keeper Dorankus at the Warehouse. Finally, collect Garmiel's Scripture from Master Trudy at the House of Elders. Take this letter as proof yo…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30130-04.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: You have helped restore some of the splendor of the Temple of Shilen that was robbed from it by those Human and Elven vermin. Take this reward with my thanks. I will give you even more if you are able to recover any other lost statues. Go and serve your goddess faithfully!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30130-05.html.text: Abyssal Celebrant Undrias: This statue is sacred to us! It is of no use to you. In fact, the Humans would burn you at the stake if they found it in your possession! Now come to your senses and give me the statue. As I told you, you will be richly rewarded for your efforts.
